data.define: A moment to show your outfit and get opinions.

misuse.text: Don't ask for a 'fit check' at the gym.

publish.title: What does "fit check" mean?
publish.value: Fit check = Showing off your outfit. Example: "Quick fit check before school!" (very casual English, US).
